title: xDrip+ help for features
body:
Hello xDrip users. I'm very satisfied by xDrip app. We are using it with Dexcom G6 only for monitoring BG on our niece 7yo.
I have 2 major questions, which answers i was unable to find.

She has phone with her all the time and it is the master device.

1. How calibration works from follower device? 
When we add calibration value from follower device a pop up came saying " calibration sent to master for processing" but nothing happens on master device neither on the graph.
The feature is checked on master device to receive calibrations from followers, but it seems it is not working.

2. Which is the setting, that show predictions for BG on the main screen?
